conviction_note: The one live line is the 2026 guide. On Italgas's own H1 numbers the run-rate puts FY adjusted net profit at roughly 770-795m against a 740-760m guide, and last year's 9M release raised guidance. The market has already been told 'probably the upper part of the range' (MF, 28 Jul), Equita models the top end, and on 2026 results days this name lagged the FTSE MIB. So p_up is 55 on an abs move of 2.7 (a regulated utility with 20% realised vol, lifted for a possible guide change), giving +0.27. The findings sum to +0.9 because the guidance finding is sized on its own.

findings.finding: Italgas's own H1 numbers imply FY2026 adjusted net profit of about 770-795m against a 740-760m guide, and adjusted EBITDA of about 2.14-2.16bn against 2.10-2.15bn. Q2 2026 adj NP was 209.2m against 180.5m in Q2 2025 (+15.9%, full 2i Rete Gas scope both years), and Q2 adj EBITDA 545.5m against 512.6m (+6.4%). H2 2025 adj NP was 361.4m (Q3 181.8 + Q4 179.6), so flat H2 growth already reaches the 760m top. Italgas raised guidance at the 9M stage last year. A raise or a 'top end/above' wording at this 9M release is therefore more likely than a plain reiteration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M 2025 (30 Oct 2025, 07:05): guidance raised together with a plan update, stock +4.17% against Snam +0.11%. H1 2026 (27 Jul): guidance confirmed 'upper part', stock -0.15% on the day against MIB +0.49%, then -3.1% and -4.5% the next two sessions (Equita TP cut on rates). Q1 2026 (5 May, first guide): +1.89% against MIB +2.27%. On 2026 release days the stock lagged the index.
findings.original_quote: Il Gruppo prevede per l'esercizio 2026: EBITDA adjusted: 2,10-2,15 miliardi di euro ... Utile Netto attribuibile al Gruppo adjusted: 0,74-0,76 miliardi di euro (Q1 release, 5 May 2026); 'I risultati sono superiori alla guidance annunciata – e già rivista al rialzo - lo scorso ottobre' (FY2025 release, 4 Mar 2026) = 'Results are above the guidance announced – and already revised upward – last October.'
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the market heard 'upper part of the range' in July and Equita models the top. What is not in the wording is that simple H2 arithmetic on the company's own quarters puts net profit 1-5% ABOVE the top. If the market priced a raise, IG would not have lagged Snam by about 11 points since 27 Jul (IG -11.5%, Snam -0.4%), and it is still about 12% below the 10.04 it closed at on H1 day.
findings.independence: Same company data. Also the FY2025 release documenting the October 2025 upward revision (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-03/20260304_178148.pdf) and Equita's 'parte alta della guidance' (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/07/28/italgas-equita-conferma-stime-ma-lima-target-price-per-rialzo-tassi-109.html).

findings.finding: IG has de-rated about 11 points against Snam since its H1 release (IG 10.04 to 8.884, -11.5%; Snam -0.4%; Terna -6.4%). Two idiosyncratic sessions (28-29 Jul, -3.1% and -4.5% against Snam about -1%) coincided with Equita cutting its TP on rates while keeping its estimates. Since the 7 Oct low the stock has recovered +10.0%, in line with Snam's +11.7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance is measurable. The de-rating was not driven by a results miss: Q2 was 'slightly better than expected' per Equita.
findings.original_quote: Ha invece limato il target price per incorporare il rialzo dei tassi registrato nelle ultime settimane (Teleborsa, 28 Jul 2026) = 'It instead trimmed the target price to incorporate the rise in rates over recent weeks.'
findings.why_not_priced: Sized at 0. The idiosyncratic part of the July drawdown has no cause in the filings, and an unexplained drawdown is worth nothing. It is filed because it sets a lower bar for an in-line print, not as an edge.

outside_window.finding: ARERA's check on whether the WACC trigger fires for 2027 (gas distribution WACC 2025-2027 confirmed for 2026 by delibera 476/2025). Summer 2026 rate rises make a trigger more plausible, which would be positive for allowed returns, but the decision comes in Nov-Dec 2026.
ATEM tender pipeline: per MF, 3 tenders expected to be finally awarded by year-end and 8 more bids due by end-2026, about 400m potential RAB.

baseline_tension: It agrees mildly. The priced lean is about zero (+0.03) and the 20-day run-up is +5.4%, which is a rates-driven sector rebound in step with Snam rather than a priced guide raise. A modest positive lean does not fight it, and the 60-day run-up (-2.5%) and the de-rating since July leave room.
language_note: The Italian FY2025 release carried the line that the 2025 guidance was 'già rivista al rialzo lo scorso ottobre'. That establishes the 9M raise precedent the finding rests on; the English searches returned only the headline figures.

Milano Finanza (Italian) carried the H1 call wording 'probabilmente nella parte alta dell'intervallo previsto' with the full guidance grid and the ATEM tender counts. The English results returned nothing comparable (MarketScreener refused).
Teleborsa (Italian) carried Equita's note: Q2 slightly better than expected, estimates kept at the upper end, TP cut purely on rates. That is the explanation for the July de-rating.
The eMarket STORAGE issuer listing (Italian OAM) settled the release timing: the Q1 and H1 timestamps were in session. It also showed no price-sensitive filing before the print.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (median 9.0% on a guidance change): abs_move_pct up from 2.3 to 2.7 for a possible 9M raise. It stays far below the stage median because this is a 20%-vol regulated utility, and that is stated rather than hidden.
'Size the move on what is new' / 'understatement': the guidance finding goes from +0.8 to +0.9 and its high end widens to +2.5.
'A drawdown with no cause in the filings is worth 0': the de-rating finding is cut from +0.2 to 0.0.
'Verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus this name lagging the index on its 2026 release days: p_up held at 55, not raised.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': H1 net debt (10.71bn) and the Floene size were checked, and nothing flags. No change.
